_meta.facet: Once Human combat deviations (deviants): skills, buffs, debuffs, scaling
_meta.gameVersion: Mixed: game-client datamine (combat profiles) from a decompile dated <= March 2026 (post Dec-18-2025 'Combat Deviations Major Upgrade'); official Steam patch notes Jul-Dec 2025 (Versions 2.0-2.2.3); community model OHMM at Version 2.3.8 (May 2026); roster/traits from ohwikiguide snapshot Sep 2026 and OHDB 2026; Version 3.0.7 (Sep 28 2026) changes known only from search summaries.
_meta.notes: Research environment could not open any game wiki / official site directly (network egress blocked; web-search quota exhausted). Primary numeric source is the game-client datamine (lReDragol/OnceHuman_Tools bd_json/deviations.json, extracted from deviation_combat_config_data.pyc etc.), whose 13 combat profiles expose formulas in 'deviation_degree'. Secondary: official Steam news text (Aug 28 2025 Polar Jelly coefficients), ohwikiguide trait text (exact player buffs), OHDB ability names, OHMM community formula model. Values marked 'inferred' follow the pattern value = step*(3+SR). Battle Skill / Ultimate texts from the Dec-2025 overhaul are only partially known (search summaries) - see openQuestions in the summary file. Percentages are plain numbers meaning percent; multipliers as decimals (8.0 = 800%).

skillRating.description: Each secured deviation has a Skill Rating 1-5 (shown as 'Deviant Power (Skill)') and an Activity Rating 1-5 (Mood). Game-client combat formulas are linear in deviation_degree: value = base + step*degree, and in every captured case base = 3*step, so value(SR) = step*(3+SR) and the SR5 value is exactly 2x the SR1 value. Interpretation of degree as SR 1..5 is supported by two independent published endpoints (Pyro Dino 19.6% -> 39.2%). If the client indexes degree 0..4 the SR1 values would be 20% lower (e.g. Butterfly 18.9%).
skillRating.confidence: medium-high for the formulas, medium for the 1..5 indexing

activityRating.description: Mood/Activity governs how long the deviation stays active (it drains in use and recovers at rest); no captured formula ties Mood to damage. OHMM lists 'scaling from activity rating and level not yet modeled'.

deviationPower.description: Deviant Power (also 'Deviation Power' / 'Energy') is the resource consumed by Battle Skills and the Ultimate after the Dec-18-2025 overhaul: the Ultimate can be activated when Deviation Power reaches max and consumes energy based on its effect; Battle Skills enter cooldown after use; switching the deployed deviation clears Deviation Power and resets the Battle Skill cooldown. Typical max pool quoted by guides: 30-100 (unverified). Modifiers: traits Covert Energy +10/20/25/30/35% max, Growing Pains +30/40/50% max, Stable Energy +30% max, Worn-Out -5/-10% max, Power Rewind +5/10% recovery, 'Infrasonic Illusion' variants +10-20% recovery, Upper Hand (legendary: at 0 Power consume all Mood to refill Power); cradle Energy Surge (night: +1 Power / 8 s; alt. airborne +6 Power / s); Dark Resonance set: Battle Skill consumes 30 Deviant Power and has -50% cooldown, +0.6% Gun & Status DMG per 1 Energy consumed up to +30%, +12% Weapon & Status DMG while Power not full, ultimate grants 10% shield for 10 s; TEC9 Additional Rules: reloading an empty magazine restores 25% magazine capacity as Deviant Power (max 20 points); Pivot Step Leather Boots: resets Battle Skill cooldown after using the Deviation Ultimate; Voodoo Doll - Starfall Inversion trait: +1 Power / 8 s (1.5 airborne).

damageScaling.description: Deviation attack/skill damage is Psi-Intensity-scaled Status/Elemental DMG (official Aug-28-2025 patch text for Polar Jelly: 'Attacks deal 800% Psi Intensity as Frost Status DMG'); community model (OHMM v2.3.8): damage = PsiIntensity x baseFactor, with Status DMG% and Elemental DMG% multipliers and no crit/weakspot by default. Not verified in-game for every deviant. Community keyword seeds for reference (not deviation-specific): Burn 10-12% Psi/stack/0.5 s, Frost Vortex 50% Psi/0.5 s for 4 s (Aug 2025), Power Surge 50% Psi (x91) vs 100% (OHMM), Unstable Bomber 70-100% Psi. Vulnerability/'DMG taken' debuffs from deviations (Weapon DMG taken, Frost/Blaze/Blast DMG taken, Weakspot DMG taken) multiply the player's own damage of that type.
damageScaling.critWeakspot: Community model: deviation skill damage cannot crit or hit weakspots (OHMM canCrit=false, canWeakspot=false) - unverified.

playerBuffsFromTraits.description: Combat-deviation trait slots give direct player buffs that a calculator should expose: Slot 2 general - Crack Shot: Weapon DMG +5%; Psychic Kid: Status DMG +5%; Run Fast: Movement Speed +5%; Heavy and Solid / Lighten your Mind: up to +15% torso/head DMG reduction by load. Slot 1/2 variant-locked - Starfall Inversion family: +5% (7.5% airborne) Melee DMG (Enchanting Void), Blaze Elemental (Invincible Sun), Frost Elemental (Polar Jelly), Status DMG (Mini Feaster), head/torso DR (Mini Wonder); Lonewolf Lunar Oracle: Weapon DMG +5% (x1.5 below 30% Sanity); Butterfly Starry Night: +6% Weapon & Status DMG at night (halved by day); Festering Gel Marine Star: random +5% Weapon or +5% Status DMG on each reload; Spring Rose: +20% healing received by day; Whalepup Don't Get Wet: +10% DR when wet. Slot 3 fused - Polar Beast: Attack +10% below 0C; Eureka Moment: attacker Weapon DMG -10% for 2 s (60 s CD).

arenaSkillsNotApplicable.description: The datamine's per-deviation 'skill_entries' (Psi Bullet, Flame Bullet, Healing Aura, ... with P.ATK/SP.ATK coefficients) belong to the 'Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve' arena pet-battle scenario, not to open-world combat, and their deviation-to-skill mapping in the extract is misaligned (e.g. Lonewolf's list matches Director Fox's). They are excluded from this file.
